name: video-script-studio
description: Turns a WeChat official-account article into a ready-to-shoot, real-person spoken script for WeChat Channels (视频号), with per-article shooting tips, layered key-quote cues, title/cover copy and hashtags. Focused on family-education content.

displayName.zh: 视频号口播文案工作室

displayDescription.en: Turns your WeChat articles into real-person spoken scripts for WeChat Channels, with shooting tips, key-quote cues and publish copy.
displayDescription.zh: 把公众号文章改编成真人出镜的视频号口播文案，含拍摄建议、金句提示、标题封面与话题标签，拿来即拍。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Turn this WeChat article into a real-person spoken script for WeChat Channels, with shooting tips, key-quote cues and publish copy.

quickPrompts.en: Here's my article. First judge the best format and length for this video, then write the spoken script.
quickPrompts.zh: 这是我的文章，先判断这条视频适合的形态和时长，再写口播稿。

quickPrompts.en: Give me the layered key quotes for this parenting video — one main quote for the big-text card plus supporting ones.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我给这条育儿视频做金句分层：一句主打做大字卡，再加几句次级金句。
